responsibility: Utility implementation file for BRIG frontend support code. It provides group-segment offset bookkeeping, operand-role classification, BRIG type width and register naming helpers, HSA/BRIG to GCC tree type mapping, host-defined global-variable detection, register-ID hashing, and diagnostic/dump helpers for register-use statistics, supplying the low-level classification and layout routines used throughout translation.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the concrete utility function definitions and bookkeeping method bodies declared in brig-util.h, such as group-segment offset calculations, BRIG type/register mapping, host-defined variable checks, and register-use dumping.
